# `packages/FolderIngestor.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/packages/FolderIngestor.js`

FolderIngestor.js — turn any developer source into a { files, entry } bundle that AppCompiler can package. Sources: • Directory picker (File System Access `showDirectoryPicker`) • <input type="file" webkitdirectory> FileList • A single HTML File • A `.zip` (Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer/File) via Zip.parse • The OS VFS (a folder path or single file) via StorageManager • A remote URL (single-file HTML; CORS-aware) Output: { files: Map<string, string|Uint8Array>, entry: string, sourceType: string, name: string } Text files are decoded to strings; binary files stay as Uint8Array.

## Classes

### `class FolderIngestor`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pickDirectory` | `static async pickDirectory()` | Native directory picker (Chromium). Walks the whole tree. |
| `fromFileList` | `static async fromFileList(fileList)` | From an <input type="file" webkitdirectory> (or multiple files) FileList. |
| `fromHtmlFile` | `static async fromHtmlFile(file)` | A single HTML file. |
| `fromZip` | `static async fromZip(input, label = 'package')` | A `.zip` archive (File | Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer). |
| `fromVfs` | `static async fromVfs(path, storage)` | A VFS folder path or single file, via a StorageManager. |
| `fromUrl` | `static async fromUrl(url, opts = {})` | A remote single-file HTML app. Resolution order: 1. The WebGPU OS browser extension's proxy-fetch bridge — fetches the page cross-origin with a real browser session, no CORS limits, no external service. Used automatically when the extension is detected. 2. A direct `fetch()` (works only for CORS-enabled / same-origin URLs). 3. An explicit CORS proxy passed via `opts.proxy`. |
| `_walkDir` | `static async _walkDir(dirHandle, prefix, files)` |  |
| `_readFile` | `static async _readFile(file, rel)` |  |
| `_finalize` | `static _finalize(files, name)` |  |

## Notes & Examples

### Packaging & trust tiers

OS apps ship as signed `.prpkg` bundles (V2: signed + encrypted + merkle + cert). A developer (self-signed) key verifies as the **community / unofficial** tier; a root-issued cert promotes it to **trusted**, and capability grants scale with the tier.

**See also:** [Security & Trust Model](/concepts/security-model.md) · [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md)

### Packaging & trust tiers

OS apps ship as signed `.prpkg` bundles (V2: signed + encrypted + merkle + cert). A developer (self-signed) key verifies as the **community / unofficial** tier; a root-issued cert promotes it to **trusted**, and capability grants scale with the tier.

**Example: Loading a package with trust check**
```js
import { PackageLoader } from 'webgpu-os/packages/PackageLoader.js';

const pkg = await PackageLoader.load('./my-app.prpkg', {
  requiredTier: 'community',  // or 'trusted' for stricter caps
  capabilities: ['storage', 'network']
});

// Trust tier determines what APIs are available
if (pkg.trustTier === 'trusted') {
  pkg.grantCapability('raw-gpu');
}
```

**See also:** [Security & Trust Model](/concepts/security-model.md) · [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md)

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
